discardEarlierFolder: This preparation belongs to an earlier version of the website. Discard it to review the current version for this folder.
folderIntro: Review the saved website pages and assets before writing them to a local folder.
earlierFolder: An unfinished export in this folder belongs to a different website revision. Choose another folder or return to the matching revision.
title: Export to a local website folder
guidance: Review the files before writing this edition. Unrelated files stay in place. Observanda does not commit, push or alter Git history.
folderGuidance: Choose the website root, or a dedicated subfolder such as site/lab-book. Relative links work in either location. Export only to a local copy; upload it after export finishes.
staging: Preparing files. Existing pages have not been switched. Resume preparation or discard it.
applying: Export needs completion: {done} of {total} files checked. Resume this edition before uploading the folder.
discarded: Preparation discarded. Review a destination to start again.
earlier: This folder has an unfinished export of an earlier edition. Inspect that edition's manifest and complete it before starting another export.
conflictHelp: A conflict is a file written outside this export, or a previously exported file that was changed or deleted. Restore the expected file, move conflicting files yourself, or choose another folder. Review the changes again afterward.
confirm: I have reviewed this pinned edition and approve these file additions, updates and removals in the selected folder.
confirmRequired: Confirm the edition and file changes before exporting.
finished: Verified files written. You can now publish this folder manually.
busy: Working on the export. You can close this dialog and reopen it from the edition review to check progress or resume after interruption.
